prompts.prompt: Create ONE full-frame opaque 16:9 environment plate, ideally 1672×941 pixels, for a side-view 2D fighting stage. Exact source: Silent Hill 3 (2003), NORMAL Hazel Street subway station CONCOURSE, the four ticket/change vending machines alcove visible in the attached native game screenshot. This is not a train platform or SH4 subway. Study the reference: four tall old vending cabinets side by side, one gray cabinet at left then three muted dark-green cabinets with silver fronts; black sloping tops, one folded newspaper draped over one green cabinet; white small square ceramic wall tiles, narrow vertical dark green tile strips, dark green skirting, gray square floor tiles, small orange-brown service door at far right. Preserve these evidenced objects/material relationships; add no benches, tracks, trains, rails, new furniture or speculative corridors. Remove Heather and every weapon/actor. Reconstruct this same wall as a wide nearly straight-on side-facing room plate: rear wall/floor junction around 63% image height, objects against rear wall at modest scale, clear continuous floor across the lower 37%, horizontal fighting-foot line at y=82.5% with no props there. Keep a slight coherent floor perspective, not top-down, not deep vanishing corridor. Dim green-gray fluorescent/flashlight-like ambient illumination, enough texture and visibility for gameplay, faithful early-2000s survival horror materials, no cinematic hyperreal embellishment. No people, monsters, human silhouettes, HUD, UI, captions, logos, readable lettering or decorative borders. Machine labels remain indistinct painted strips. Fill every pixel including corners with the environment; no transparency and no vignette matte. One scene only. The output is a source-guided versus reconstruction, not a screenshot or certified exact replica.

Create ONE full-frame opaque wide 16:9 environment plate, ideally 1672×941 pixels, for a side-view 2D fighting stage. Exact source is Silent Hill 3 (2003) NORMAL Underpass UPPER LEVEL MAP ROOM, before the sewer canal; both attached native game screenshots show this SAME room. Preserve the observed distressed teal-green wall with dark horizontal lower trim and pale rectangular paper route map, rusty metal locker cabinet fallen diagonally along the wall at the right, gray metal drum at far left, dark gritty concrete floor and bare industrial wall planes. These exact restricted room details define this plate. Remove Heather, the handheld weapon, and the collectible spiked maul; no actors or monsters. Do not mix in the canal, water monster, kerosene heater room, bloody Extra New Game walls or later construction site. Reorient only this map-wall bay into a nearly straight-on side-facing composition suitable for a 2D duel. Rear wall meets floor at y=62%; the fallen locker and drum are entirely at the rear, their lowest pixels above y=69%; lower 31% is unobstructed continuous concrete floor with horizontal foot contact line y=82.5%. Broaden the visible floor conservatively; do not invent another room or machinery. Dark subdued cold green-gray illumination, rusty brown metal, quiet readable floor, original early-2000s game material mood rather than dramatic modern redesign. No people, creatures, bodies, HUD, text overlays, logos, readable map lettering or borders. No foreground bars. Opaque to all edges, one scene, no collage. Source-guided camera/floor adaptation is acceptable; identity and world state must match the references.

Create ONE full-frame opaque 16:9 environment plate, ideally 1672×941, for a side-view 2D fighting stage. Exact source: Silent Hill 3 (2003), NIGHTMARE / Otherworld Hilltop Center, FIFTH FLOOR GALLERY OF FINE ARTS, the specific 'Flame Purifies All' painting wall BEFORE the painting is burned. Use the attached native gameplay capture as the strict identity reference. Keep the large aged rectangular gilt picture frame in the central back wall with its dim reddish historical religious painting; preserve the art as a small indistinct painted image, never a living figure. Keep the two narrow caged vertical fluorescent fixtures flanking it, mottled ivory/rust wall panels with heavy dark-red corrosion, dark metal base trim, and the continuous rusty rectangular grated floor. Keep the small metal bucket under the painting at the BACK wall, not in the fighting lane. Remove Heather and all weapons/actors; there are no real people, monsters or bodies in this room plate. Reframe this exact shallow bay wider and straighter, rear wall/floor junction y=60%, bucket base above y=65%, lower40% continuous level grating, horizontal clear combat-foot line y=82.5%. Restrained original-game lighting, warm rusty dark brown/ivory palette, no additional decorative furniture, sculpture, extra painting, bones, hanging bodies, huge pipes or invented doorways. The two tiny wall lamps light the wall, not a theatrical spotlight. No HUD, captions, readable letters, logo, border, montage or transparent pixels. One coherent source-guided environment; original material and room identity matter more than cinematic realism. This is a versus camera reconstruction, not certified1:1.

Create ONE separate FOREGROUND PARALLAX OVERLAY PNG with TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY, ideally1672×941 wide16:9, exactly aligned to the attached room plate. The scene is Silent Hill3 Otherworld Hilltop Center, fifth-floor Gallery of Fine Arts at the Flame Purifies All painting wall before burning. This overlay contains ONLY a very narrow close crop of the rust-stained ivory wall return at the extreme LEFT x0..3%, and another at the extreme RIGHT x97..100%. Use the same dark corroded wall material, vertical near-camera edge, and original-game lighting from the attached room. These are restrained enlarged edges of the existing architecture; do not invent props. The entire central94% must be fully transparent from top through bottom: no painting, lamps, bucket, floor, ceiling, crossbar, background or haze. Keep transparent fight footing at y75..90%.
